 UFC Fight Night: Aleksandre Topuria vs Santiago Luna Preview & Prediction

 Aleksandre Topuria returns from a year out the octagon to close out the prelims, taking on the young Mexican prospect Santiago Luna at bantamweight.

 Aleksandre Topuria: The other Topuria, cut from the same cloth
 Aleksandre Topuria (7-1) is 2-0 in the UFC, with unanimous decisions over Colby Thicknesse and Bekzat Almakhan, though he hasn’t fought since last November. He’s a very similar archetype to his younger brother Ilia, a compact, measured boxer who stalks behind a patient, disciplined guard. He’s defensively sound and efficient rather than high volume, working the head and body with only the occasional low kick. He backs it up with strong defensive wrestling, good takedowns of his own and dominant top control with opportunistic submissions. That Thicknesse win also looks better with every fight, with Thicknesse since beating the hyped Asaf Chopurov. This is a ranked level fighter we have on our hands.
 Santiago Luna: Prospect coming off his first loss
 Santiago Luna (8-1) is coming off the first loss of his career, a late third round submission against Bryce Mitchell in June. Like Topuria, Luna is an orthodox shoot boxer, but he fights at a far higher pace, swarming opponents with combinations to the head and body before following up with takedown pressure. He throws more and lands more, but he isn’t as defensively sound, and he can be outgrappled by higher-level wrestlers. On the mat, he’s relentless, hunting the back and submissions rather than settling for control and position.
 Aleksandre Topuria vs Santiago Luna prediction
 I think Luna is going to have a hard time in this matchup. Topuria is the stronger wrestler, the more composed boxer and the more defensively sound fighter, and I don’t see Luna swarming him the way he can lesser opponents. Luna has the pace and aggression advantage, but Topuria’s tight, disciplined guard is built to absorb exactly that kind of pressure.
 Topuria isn’t as experienced as Bryce Mitchell, but I see him as a tougher matchup for Luna. He has similar control wrestling, without Mitchell’s submission ability, but with far sharper boxing to go with it, which makes him the more well-rounded fighter. Mitchell spent most of that fight on top of Luna, and Topuria has the tools to do the same while winning the striking exchanges on the way in.
 A big reason Luna’s style doesn’t suit this fight is what he does from winning positions. He opens up too much on the ground, and against a grappler like Topuria, throwing ground and pound and chasing submissions so aggressively will just give him openings to escape or reverse. 
 Give me Topuria to win with the more effective skillset in this matchup. This pick is a lock.
 Prediction: Aleksandre Topuria to win
